preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100,000, and k is between 1 and n.
Both n and k have the same remainder when divided by 2.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string s is exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string s is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: exists l such that 1 <= l <= |s| - k + 1 and s[l:l+k] is the only substring of s with length k
postconditions.description: There exists at least one substring of s with length k that is unique.
